dict.string: filo forwards the music app you select to your output device. Audio stays on your Mac. Optional reference-lab diagnostics can save test samples locally.
filo reads your player's current track and playback state to match your output format. It does not modify your library.

Exclusive preview uses BlackHole's virtual audio input, which macOS protects with microphone permission. filo selects the virtual device, not your physical microphone. The optional laboratory also uses virtual loopback inputs.
